name: 4-Across: screen for 1
subtitle: 4-Across variation, when 4 and 5 are shut down
goal: If they take away both sidelines, free the point guard in the middle.
options: Best: 1 coming back to the ball off 2's screen. Then 1 looks long to 4 or 5.

steps.note: 4 and 5 are shut down, so they go long. 2 screens for 1.
1 comes off the screen back toward the ball. 3 passes to 1.
3 steps in behind the ball as the safety. 1 looks up the floor.
